segments.name: Commercial Banking
segments.description: A full-service Georgia commercial bank serving small- and medium-sized businesses and individuals through branches in multi-ethnic communities, offering loans and deposits.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, all of the financial service operations are considered by management to be aggregated in one reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay interest and fees on loans, primarily residential real estate and SBA loans, while depositors are paid interest; the bank also sells SBA loan guarantees for premium income.
revenueModel.evidence: Interest income and noninterest income generated from our residential real estate and SBA loans provide the primary revenue in the operating segment.
